run_findings.phase1_direct_chat_transaction: The inspected GitHub surface supports a repository-only durable sequence: SHA-only freshness read; deterministic create-only file/ref claim; immutable checkpoint create plus exact commit-SHA readback; mutable pointer update with current blob-SHA precondition; deterministic branch/head PR preparation with search-before-retry; review pinned to commit_id; final merge pinned by expected_head_sha. Every ambiguous mutation requires read-before-retry.
run_findings.contents_cas_boundary: GitHub Contents update uses the current file blob SHA and can return 409; this is per-path CAS, not a multi-file or branch-head transaction. GitHub documents serializing content update/delete requests.
run_findings.claim_boundary: Create-only file paths or deterministic refs are stronger exclusive claims than additive labels/assignees, but neither has automatic TTL/stale recovery. Stale ownership must be proven from claim metadata before reclaim.
run_findings.ref_update_boundary: update_ref(force=false) provides fast-forward overwrite protection but is not strict expected-old-SHA CAS.
run_findings.pr_merge_boundary: GitHub sync merge accepts a PR-head SHA precondition and returns 409 on mismatch; connected merge_pull_request exposes expected_head_sha, making it the strongest inspected direct exclusive handoff primitive.
run_findings.background_boundary: GitHub public REST supports workflow_dispatch, but connected tool discovery in this invocation exposed workflow readback and rerun actions, not a fresh dispatch action. Actions concurrency/artifacts therefore require an existing background runner execution. Argo requires Kubernetes plus a resident Workflow Controller; Temporal durable replay requires Temporal Service plus Worker processes. Configuration alone is not execution.
run_findings.temporal_retry_counterexample: Temporal documents that an Activity may execute or partially complete more than once even when completion is observed exactly once; write Activities should be idempotent and external effects can use idempotency keys. This is a public counterexample to treating retry-safe orchestration as executed-once side effects.
